title.narrative: Integrated Assistance to Flood Affected Communities

description.narrative:
Overall objective: Provide immediate relief to flood affected population of Pakistan through multi-sectoral integrated service provision to stabilize the current situation and initiating medium term recovery actions to link to longer-term development needs while instilling elements of prevention of conflicts and tension at the community level.

Expected Result: Children have access to education, water, sanitation and hygiene services, and to child protection services, as part of the recovery process.
